meta_description: Matthews Tree Services in Manchester. Professional tree care, pruning, felling and stump removal. Same-day quotes available. Call 07515 964715.
hero_eyebrow: NPTC Certified Arborist — Emergency Tree Removal
hero_subhead: Dangerous branches hanging over your roof? We'll assess, quote, and remove safely — often the same day.
services_heading: Complete Tree Care Services Across Manchester
services_subhead: From routine pruning to emergency storm damage clearance, we handle every job with certified expertise and proper insurance.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe, controlled felling of dead, diseased or dangerous trees. We handle awkward locations, tight gardens, and properties near buildings with precision.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Reduce weight and improve shape without harming the tree. Ideal for overhanging branches, light improvement, and long-term tree health.

services.title: Stump Grinding
services.desc: Complete stump removal below ground level using specialist machinery. Leaves your garden level and ready for replanting or landscaping.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Swift response to fallen trees and storm damage. We'll clear debris, make the site safe, and document everything for your insurer.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Remedial Work
services.desc: Cavity filling, branch support systems, and disease management to preserve valuable or heritage trees.

services.title: Hedge & Shrub Cutting
services.desc: Seasonal maintenance and hard pruning. We'll restore overgrown hedges and keep your garden boundaries neat and healthy.

about_pullquote: I only do the job I'd want done to my own trees.
about_para_1: Matthews Tree Services was founded 18 years ago by Chris Matthews, a fully qualified NPTC-certified arborist who grew tired of seeing Manchester's trees damaged by untrained contractors. What started as one man with a van has grown into a trusted team handling everything from routine garden pruning to complex felling jobs on listed properties. We're fully insured and accredited — your trees (and your peace of mind) are in safe hands.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, giving honest quotes, and leaving your garden cleaner than we found it. We don't cut corners with safety, and we never oversell work you don't need. Over 80% of our new work comes from recommendations and repeat customers — that's how we know we're doing it right.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Property Owners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive oak tree leaning towards the house after the storm last month. Chris came out, took his time explaining what needed doing, and quoted fair. The work was done in a day, all debris cleared, and the site left immaculate. Proper job. Wouldn't hesitate to call them again.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Our hedge had got completely out of control. Called Matthews on a Wednesday morning expecting a wait, but they came out Friday and had it sorted by lunchtime. The difference is night and day. Very professional team and not the crazy prices some of these other lot charge.
reviews.author: Jennifer M.

reviews.text: Needed a stump ground out from a tree that came down in our garden. Got a same-day quote, job done within the week, all the wood chipped and taken away. Chris was friendly, knowledgeable, and answered every question. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Robert K.
